tasks.label: Setup & Start FastAPI Backend
args: cd backend; if (-not (Test-Path .venv)) { echo 'Creating Virtual Environment...'; python -m venv .venv }; echo 'Installing Dependencies...'; .venv/Scripts/pip install -r requirements.txt; echo 'Generating Data & Training ML Model...'; .venv/Scripts/python ml/generate_data.py; .venv/Scripts/python ml/train_model.py; echo 'Starting FastAPI Server...'; .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload

tasks.label: Setup & Start Next.js Frontend
args: cd frontend; echo 'Installing Frontend Dependencies...'; npm install; echo 'Starting Next.js Dev Server...'; npm run dev
